reviewSummary: ACCEPT at zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody holds at the expected digest and mode 0444. All 23 file-backed pins and HEAD reproduce; all JSON inputs pass strict duplicate-key rejection. Frozen v5 remains current at draft time and becomes historical only after this successor is recorded; occupancy v2 / D-217 remains current; D-086/D-145 remain naming authority. The exact two-member leftoverDesign set is preserved, occupancy v2 closes nothing new, activation stays on DR-118, exact SDK APIs/frameworks remain reserved, the one named corpus class remains unauthored, and the two historical findings are carried as landed at v5 rather than re-landed at v6.
